brief:
# Model UPGRADES need Brett's approval; downgrades don't (Urgent, Opus)

Replaces the stopped build model-switch-approval (folder /root/axf-builds/model-switch-approval, ignore any work there).

Brett Nov 3 2026 (voice), angry: a headless build (agent-swarm-fable-rebuild, PR #247) approved its own Opus -> Fable phase switch in the orchestrator (`orchestrator.mjs act approve`) because its brief said "do every step". Brett: "It cannot be switching the model without my approval. That's not even a veto. That's an approval." Then: "You can downgrade, but you can't upgrade."

New project rule (add to _claude/rules/RULES.md and the decisions log, dated Nov 3 2026): a build may switch to a LOWER model on its own (downgrade, e.g. Fable -> Opus): allowed, no approval, just recorded. Switching to a HIGHER model (upgrade, e.g. Opus -> Fable) needs Brett's explicit APPROVAL (confirm policy), never a veto countdown and never self-approved by a session, agent, headless build or the orchestrator. Ranking: Fable is above Opus (Brett's call). Put the ranking in model-policy (one ordered list, config not code) so future models slot in. A session that reaches an upgrade stops there and asks.

Enforce it:
1. orchestrator approve/phase logic (orchestrator-core.mjs apply + CLI + console server): a downgrade phase passes by itself (record it); an upgrade phase refuses unless approved by Brett: his own signed-in console click or an axHub approval he approves. Detect non-human sources with the same signals used for 'who asked' on approvals (X-Axhub-Source, AXF headless env, agent env). Record who approved and when.
2. vps.build_start / claude-headless.sh / agent job router: launching or relaunching a build on a higher model than its orchestrator step's model is an upgrade too: refuse or hold for approval the same way.
3. Briefs (orchestrator `brief`, headless guidance, agent jobs): say plainly upgrades need Brett and the session stops and asks; downgrades are fine. Remove any wording that lets a session approve an upgrade.
4. Request path: an axHub approval (confirm policy, not veto) titled with the build, the phase and from -> to model; approving it records the approval in the orchestrator.
5. Audit: list every upgrade approved so far by a non-human source (the store's journal), report in the PR; mark agent-swarm-fable-rebuild's s7 Opus -> Fable as self-approved (not Brett's). Note: xlayout-opus and token-control-opus were Fable -> Opus (downgrades), fine under the new rule.
6. Tests for refusal, downgrade pass-through and the approval path; THREADS row (profile urgent); PR (push banner merges it).

Rules: one session, no sub-agents, stay on Opus. Don't approve any phase yourself while doing this.

steps.text: Ranking + switch rules in model-policy; framework/core/model-switch.mjs (who may approve, phases, held steps)
Orchestrator core: downgrade passes + recorded, upgrade needs approver; request-upgrade/deny-upgrade; edit-step raise; briefs
CLI + console server + console MCP tool (axHub confirm path): approver only from Brett
Launcher gate (model-gate.mjs from claude-headless.sh) + swarm planner gate
Audit + mark self-approved; rules, decisions, README, CLAUDE.md
Tests (orchestrator, swarm, model-policy, server), THREADS, PR
